attempts.sql: SELECT DISTINCT f_target.file_id AS file_path FROM code.imports i JOIN code.files f_src ON i.file_id = f_src.file_id JOIN code.files f_target ON i.imported_file_id = f_target.file_id WHERE i.is_internal = TRUE AND f_src.file_id IN ('httpx/_client.py', 'httpx/_models.py') AND f_target.package = 'httpx' GROUP BY f_target.file_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT f_src.file_id) = 2 ORDER BY file_path
